decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper is a natural extension of the established construction range, and two years on the market is too short to justify withdrawal.
The articulated dumper uses the firm's core rugged-vehicle competence, rounds out its construction portfolio and costs little to keep offering.
The mine rescue vehicle is a niche product distant from the core offer, but it fits the firm's underground specialist profile, and such long-cycle mining products are usually given several years.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is a substantial investment in an adjacent lifting segment, making early withdrawal unlikely.
The material lift line is reported as the most popular rental lift and recently won a large order, so it is clearly successful.
The compact mining loader shows a strong field record of 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which supports keeping and expanding it.
